title: Unit review quiz
subject: PSHE
source: Seeded from pshe/y3 lesson 13 (Unit review quiz (pupil PDF))
intro: Covers lessons 8 to 13 of Daring to be different. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: According to 49:13, who is best in the sight of Allah?
options: The one with the most taqwa
questions.a: A) The one with the most taqwa. 49:13: the most noble is the most righteous.

questions.q: Which is the best thought when a friend wins a prize?
options: MashaAllah, well done! I'll keep trying too
I'll never be good at anything
questions.a: A) MashaAllah, well done! I'll keep trying too. Be happy for others and keep trying.

questions.q: Someone online asks you to keep a secret from your parents. You should ...
questions.a: A) Tell a trusted adult. A secret that hides something from parents is unsafe: tell.

questions.q: What do we say when something does not go our way?
questions.a: A) Qaddarallahu wa ma sha'a fa'al. Allah decreed it and did as He willed: we accept and keep trying.

questions.q: What usually happens to a big worry we never share?
questions.a: A) It can grow bigger. Bottled-up feelings can grow; sharing helps.
A) 'Please stop. I don't like that.'. Calm, clear and kind: assertive.
